reason: The text explicitly states that King Hezekiah commanded the Hebrew people on the wall not to answer or respond to the words of Rab-shakeh (the Assyrian envoy). The passage reads: 'וְהֶחֱרִישׁוּ הָעָם וְלֹא־עָנוּ אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ הִיא לֵאמֹר לֹא תַעֲנֻהוּ' ('And the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not'). This directly shows the Hebrew people being explicitly commanded to remain silent and refrain from expressing their views in response to the Assyrian threats.
